'''Nogometni Klub Rudeš''' ({{langx|en|Football Club Rudeš}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Rudeš''', is a Croatian [[association football|football]] club founded in 1957 in [[Zagreb]]'s neighbourhood of [[Rudeš]]. The club competes in [[Croatian Football League]], the top tier of [[Croatian football league system|Croatian football]]."}}
